tex_content.html:
Remark
[Meaning of ``closed operator''] ↗ thm:semigroup-generator-properties 1. ch7:7.4.1-rem-2\group Semigroup Theory

Closedness means that $u_k\in D(A)$, $u_k\to u$, and $Au_k\to v$ imply \[ u\in D(A),\qquad Au=v. \]
